Persist CodeOn notifications in PostgreSQL (#157)

codeon:
  version: 1
  authority: fewensa-33
  description: |-
    ## Summary
    
    - add additive PostgreSQL migrations for notification consumer checkpoints, frozen outbox deliveries, and delivery attempts
    - implement the profile-bound PostgreSQL notification store with atomic routing/checkpoint advancement, fenced claims and leases, retry/terminal/ambiguous transitions, and expired-lease recovery
    - add PostgreSQL acceptance coverage and document the persistence contract
    
    ## Verification
    
    - `cargo fmt --all -- --check`
    - `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings`
    - `cargo test --workspace --locked`
    - `cargo test -p codeon-postgres --locked`
    - `cargo test -p codeon-postgres --test notification_persistence --features postgres-acceptance --locked`
    - `cargo test -p codeon-postgres --test migration_acceptance --features postgres-acceptance --locked`
